info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Financial Statement Assessment API
info.description: The Financial Statement Assessment API provides critical tools for evaluating the financial statements of banking clients. By leveraging this API, financial analysts can access comprehensive assessment data to ensure compliance and make informed decisions. Typical consumers include financial institutions, regulatory bodies, and compliance officers who need to validate and review financial documentation. This API streamlines the assessment process, enhancing efficiency and accuracy in maintaining financial integrity.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch detailed assessments of financial statements, including associated compliance metrics and relevant data. It's essential for ensuring that financial reporting meets regulatory standards.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to initiate a financial statement assessment operation. It should include all necessary parameters to retrieve the relevant financial data for compliance checking.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the financial statement assessment.
